name: Purple Boa
body:
## What's Changed
* Use bats-core/bats-action to set up Bats by @jparise in https://github.com/rcaloras/bash-preexec/pull/176
* Mention Ghostty by @jparise in https://github.com/rcaloras/bash-preexec/pull/172
* Test against Bash 3.2, 4.4, 5.0, and 5.3 in CI by @rcaloras in https://github.com/rcaloras/bash-preexec/pull/177
* Use a function substitution in `$PS0` for preexec in Bash >= 5.3 by @akinomyoga in https://github.com/rcaloras/bash-preexec/pull/166
* Re-adjust `PROMPT_COMMAND` when `PROMPT_COMMAND` is modified elsewhere by @akinomyoga in https://github.com/rcaloras/bash-preexec/pull/143
* fix: Allow __bp_precmd_invoke_cmd to be called from __bp_install. by @JeffFaer in https://github.com/rcaloras/bash-preexec/pull/184
* fix: Properly check to see if we're already installed in PROMPT_COMMAND. by @JeffFaer in https://github.com/rcaloras/bash-preexec/pull/185
* fix preexec for the first command by @Rogach in https://github.com/rcaloras/bash-preexec/pull/180
* Preserve $? and $_ on __bp_precmd_invoke_cmd early returns by @gnachman in https://github.com/rcaloras/bash-preexec/pull/187
* Remove the local declarations of `{preexec,precmd}_functions` by @akinomyoga in https://github.com/rcaloras/bash-preexec/pull/182

Special shout out to @akinomyoga for continued supports as primary collaborator/maintainer of this repo. 

## New Contributors
* @JeffFaer made their first contribution in https://github.com/rcaloras/bash-preexec/pull/184
* @Rogach made their first contribution in https://github.com/rcaloras/bash-preexec/pull/180
* @gnachman made their first contribution in https://github.com/rcaloras/bash-preexec/pull/187

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/rcaloras/bash-preexec/compare/0.6.0...0.7.0
